A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.description: DSH web plugin: a Smart Prompt button under the composer that rewrites your draft into a structured prompt grounded in the project documents you declare (AGENTS.md / README.md), capped at 400 characters, configured entirely by the caller.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-smartprompt

A [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web plugin that adds a **Smart Prompt** button
under the composer. Click it and your rough draft is rewritten into a structured, executable prompt
grounded in your workspace conventions — then filled straight back into the composer.

```
┌─ composer (draft: "make the login form safer") ─┐
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  ✨ Smart Prompt          ← appears only while the draft is non-empty
```

- Empty draft → the button is not rendered.
- Click → the button shows *Optimizing…*, the result replaces the draft, the button turns into *✓ Optimized*.
- Failure → one line of explanation next to the button (timeout / no model / model error); the draft is untouched.
- Each click leaves one `command/run` + `command/done` pair in the session log (that is how DSH's command
  channel works). The plugin renders that as a single-line summary in the conversation
  (*✨ Smart Prompt · N chars · Fill composer*), never as the whole prompt.

中文摘要见文末。

## Install

Three routes, in order of availability today:

| Route | Command | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Git (works now) | `plugin_manager(action="install_bundle", target="github:shellpower96/dsh-prompt-optimizer#v0.1.0")` | ✅ published |
| DSH Discover (market index) | add `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shellpower96/dsh-prompt-optimizer/main/market/index.json` as an index source | ✅ published |
| npm | `npm i -g dsh-smartprompt` / `install_bundle dsh-smartprompt` | ⏳ name reserved, publish pending |

The package name is **`dsh-smartprompt`** (the npm name `dsh-prompt-optimizer` already belongs to a
different project). The repository keeps its original name, so every git spec stays valid.


DSH's plugin catalog is the package manager itself — there is no separate submission portal.
Install this bundle from its git repository:

```text
plugin_manager(action="install_bundle", target="github:shellpower96/dsh-prompt-optimizer#v0.1.0")
```

...or from a local checkout while developing:

```text
plugin_manager(action="install_bundle", target="/absolute/path/to/dsh-prompt-optimizer")
```

Installing needs `pnpm` on `PATH` (the plugin manager runs `pnpm add`); without it you get
`spawn pnpm ENOENT`. Remove with:

```text
plugin_manager(action="remove_bundle", target="dsh-prompt-optimizer")
```

The Host half registers the command; the Client half ships as a browser module via
`dsh.client`. Installing a new bundle can arrive over HMR — if the button does not appear,
refresh the page once.

## Minimal example

An empty config is enough:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: prompt-optimizer
      name: 'dsh-prompt-optimizer'
      config: {}
```

To point it at your own conventions (this is the only integration surface — the plugin assumes
no project layout):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: prompt-optimizer
      name: 'dsh-prompt-optimizer'
      config:
        docs: ['AGENTS.md', 'README.md', 'docs/architecture.md']
        contextChars: 6000
        systemPromptLocale: auto
```

## Configuration

Every value is read from the row's `config`; the plugin reads no environment variables and no
settings module of its own. Invalid values throw at activation with the field name.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch; `false` registers nothing |
| `maxDraftChars` | `4000` | Reject longer drafts instead of sending them to the model |
| `contextChars` | `8000` | Total character budget for the project-facts block |
| `maxOutputChars` | `400` | Character cap for the optimized prompt, defined in Chinese characters; the English ceiling scales to 1.8x. The meta prompt targets 75% of it, so the hard cap only trims a runaway answer |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | Per-call timeout |
| `docs` | `["AGENTS.md","README.md"]` | Workspace-relative documents read as facts, in order; missing files are skipped, absolute paths and `..` are rejected |
| `includeGoal` | `true` | Include the session's current goal in the facts block |
| `systemPromptLocale` | `"auto"` | Language of the meta prompt: `auto` follows the draft's script, `zh`/`en` force one. The produced prompt always follows the draft's language |

## How the prompt is produced

The meta prompt pins five properties (`src/prompt.js`):

1. **Faithful** — clarify, complete, structure; never widen or narrow scope. User decisions become `TBD: …`.
2. **Grounded** — modules, files, commands, conventions and test approaches may only be named if they
   actually appear in the facts block; otherwise the model writes *needs locating* instead of inventing them.
3. **Structured** — Goal / Current state and landing spot / Constraints and conventions / Task breakdown /
   Acceptance criteria; empty sections are dropped.
4. **Executable** — acceptance criteria must be verifiable (a command, an observable behavior, a concrete file).
5. **Concise** — one length budget per locale, expressed in that locale's native unit (Chinese characters /
   English words), plus a bullet discipline: at most 3 bullets per section and 10 in total, no background
   preamble, no restating the draft, no duplicated constraints.
6. **Body only** — no preamble, no reasoning, no code fence; `finalizeOptimizedText()` strips a fence or
   preamble the model adds anyway.

### Length budget

With the default `maxOutputChars: 400`:

| Locale | Target written into the meta prompt | Hard ceiling on the result | Token budget |
|---|---|---|---|
| zh | 300 字 | 400 characters | 334 |
| en | 94 words | 720 characters | 600 |

The target sits below the ceiling on purpose, so a compliant answer is never truncated. If a model
overruns anyway, `finalizeOptimizedText()` cuts at the last complete line (falling back to a sentence
end, then a word break, then a hard cut) and appends a single `…` — it never slices mid-sentence and
never writes explanatory text into the prompt body.

## Layout

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host entry: validate config, register `/optimize-prompt` |
| `src/config.js` | Defaults + hand-written validation (fails loudly) |
| `src/facts.js` | Fact collection: read-only, bounded, never throws; branch comes from `.git/HEAD`, no subprocess |
| `src/prompt.js` | Pure: draft parsing, meta-prompt assembly (zh/en), output cleanup |
| `src/optimize.js` | Orchestration: parse → collect → resolve model route → stream → clean |
| `client.js` | Browser half: composer button, command-row renderer, copy |

Model route: the session Agent's own `provider`/`model` wins, then the process default model
selection (`ctx.agentDefaultModel`). The call goes through `ctx.llm.stream()`, so `llm/stream`
middleware still applies.

## Tests

```bash
node --test
```

Three groups: public-API unit tests, **no-project-context instantiation** (no `fs`, no `cwd`,
no `goals`, no default model — assertions are "explicit outcome, never an uncaught throw"), and a
project-context regression that drives the plugin with a caller-declared `docs` list.

## Known limits

- **Only renders once a session exists.** The button lives in `conversation.composer.dock`
  (scope `session`), so a brand-new conversation's first screen has no button; it appears after the
  first message.
- **The command name is fixed** (`optimize-prompt`): both halves build the command line from a
  shared constant, and DSH rejects two registrations of the same name in one scope. Renaming it
  means editing `index.js` and `client.js` together.
- **Not a tool**: the plugin changes no system prompt and adds no agent tool.
- **Length is a soft promise plus one hard cut**: models are asked to stay inside the budget; the cap is
  only a guard rail. Raising `maxOutputChars` raises both the target and the ceiling. Every default in
  `src/prompt.js` derives from this one config value, so they cannot drift apart.
- Verified against **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2**. No `peerDependencies` are declared on purpose: DSH blocks
  installation on an incompatible peer, which would be worse than a documented version note.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

---

在 DSH Web 输入框下方加一个「✨ 智能提示词」按钮：有草稿时才出现，点击后结合**会话工作目录里
你自己声明的项目文档**（默认 `AGENTS.md` / `README.md`）、git 分支与会话目标，把

plugins.description: 不再渲染 Markdown 删除线，并还原被区间号吃掉的 ~ 字符。覆盖聊天、思考过程与会话文档预览。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ban-strikethrough

DSH 插件：**禁止删除线渲染**。在 Harness Web GUI 的聊天、思考过程，以及会话文档预览的 Markdown 页里取消删除线，并把被吃掉的 `~` 字符还原回文本。

- 包名：`dsh-ban-strikethrough`
- Loader 行 id：`ban-strikethrough`
- 形态：Host 空壳（`index.js`）+ 浏览器半边（`client.js`，通过 `package.json` 的 `dsh.client` 声明）

## 为什么会有这个插件

Web 端的 Markdown 渲染器（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 的直接 mdast→React 渲染）用的 GFM 语法扩展沿用了 micromark 的默认值 `singleTilde: true`，也就是**一个** `~` 就能开一个删除线区间，下一个 `~` 就关掉它。而单个 `~` 在中文技术写作里正是「某某至某某」的区间号，于是一段话里出现两个区间就会互相配对：

```
要求 200400~稳定只给~113134
        └──── 中间全部被划掉，两个 ~ 被吃掉 ────┘
```

模型从来不是要表达「删除」，而渲染结果既难看又丢字符（`3~5` 直接显示成 `35`）。

## 做了什么

`client.js` 在插件生命周期内注入一张样式表（`ctx.effect` 注册，卸载/停用即移除）：

```css
del,
s,
strike { text-decoration: none; }

del::before,
del::after { content: "~"; text-decoration: none; }
```

- 第一条取消删除线本身。
- 第二条把被解析器吃掉的区间号还回文本，于是渲染结果和模型写下的原文逐字符一致。

选择 `del` 元素作为唯一选择器，是因为整个 Web 客户端里**只有** Markdown 渲染器会产出 `<del>`（`case "delete": jsx("del", …)`），而且宿主样式表没有给这个元素写任何规则，所以普通作者规则就能压过浏览器的 UA `line-through`。

### 覆盖范围

| 位置 | 是否覆盖 | 原因 |
|---|---|---|
| 聊天消息、思考过程 | ✅ | 走同一个 Markdown 原语 |
| 会话文档预览的 Markdown 页 | ✅ | `MarkdownBody` 用的就是该原语的 `MarkdownText` |
| 终端 ANSI 删除线（SGR 9） | ❌ 故意不动 | 那是行内 `text-decoration`，是终端内容的真实属性 |
| HTML / PDF / Excel 预览 | ❌ | 独立 iframe 文档，内容是文件自己的，不是模型写的 Markdown |
| 输入框富文本编辑器 | ❌ | 用的是行内 mark，与渲染无关 |

## 文件

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | 包清单：`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`（`platform: web`、`immediately: true`）+ 导出与 `files` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 一条 Host 行 `ban-strikethrough`，让插件在插件列表里有独立开关 |
| `index.js` | Host 半边，空实现（行为全在浏览器半边） |
| `client.js` | 浏览器半边：注册工厂 + 注入样式表 |
| `locale/en.json`、`locale/zh.json` | 插件卡片上的标题与说明 |
| `icon.svg` | 插件图标（禁止删除线） |
| `bundle-check.mjs` | 安装前离线自检：清单、`./client` 解析、用 Harness 自己的 loader 解析 patch |

## 安装与开关

已经通过 Plugin Manager 的 `install_bundle` 安装并启用（profile `web`，`application: applied`，无 warning）。再次安装或重装：

```
plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "D:\\桌面\\DSH与自动化\\dsh-delete-line-display" }
```

- 停用/启用：插件列表里找「禁止删除线」，或 `plugin_manager { action: "set_bundle", target: "dsh-ban-strikethrough", enabled: false }`。
- 安装会改 profile（`bundles` 列表 + profile 依赖），所以必须用 Plugin Manager，不要手改 profile。
- 停用后样式表随插件卸载一起移除，不需要重启 Harness；**页面刷新一次**最稳妥。

## 验证

已做的（离线/服务端）：

1. `node --check index.js client.js bundle-check.mjs`；
2. `node bundle-check.mjs` → 15 项全 PASS，包括用 Harness 自己的 loader（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` 的 `loadOverlayPatches`）解析 `cordis.patch.yml`；
3. `cordis_inspect_query`（Host `Config.listConfigs`，name = `dsh-ban-strikethrough`）能看到活着的 Loader 行 `include:ban-strikethrough`。

**没做的：页面里的视觉确认。** 本会话没有浏览器控制，而「样式表是否真的生效」只有那个已打开的页面能证明。请刷新该页面后自测：

- 一段话里放两个区间，例如 `范围 3~5 天，稳定后 10~20 天`：应显示原样的 `~`，没有任何横线；
- 打开一个含 `~` 区间的 `.md` 文件，在会话文档预览里看同一段：同样无横线；
- `~~这样的~~` 应显示为 `~这样的~`（不划线，保留一个 `~`）。

## 已知取舍

- 还原出来的 `~` 是 CSS 伪元素内容，**选中复制**时是否带上它取决于浏览器；`del` 里的正文本身从来都在。
- 原文写的是 `~~双波浪号~~` 时只会还原成一个 `~`（CSS 无从得知定界符长度）。考虑到「有意写删除线」的概率约等于零，这个偏差可以接受。
- 如果哪天也想禁掉终端 ANSI 删除线，在同一个样式表里加一条针对行内 `text-decoration` 的规则即可，但那会牺牲终端输出的保真度，所以默认不做。

# dsh-lfaa

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A complete native DSH plugin project with independently owned business modules. Appearance, layout, cards, dialogs and motion are one capability group, not the definition of the whole plugin. This is a new project designed around DSH; it does not copy or migrate the old LFAA project.

DSH owns accounts, all AI execution, sessions, models, subagents, tool dispatch and approval. The plugin contributes its own business through public interfaces and keeps business data local when needed. No second harness, login or conversation store is introduced.

## Repository

```text
packages/
  dsh-lfaa/              Plugin composition and distribution manifest
  dsh-lfaa-workspace/    Left menu, main workspace, Session tab, right pane, Settings
  dsh-lfaa-appearance/   Appearance schema and reversible theme/motion projection
scripts/                 Build and repository checks
tests/                   Focused regression tests
docs/                    Architecture, extension contracts and validation
dist/                    Generated output only; ignored
```

Package directories and manifest names use the `dsh-` prefix. Private implementation packages are bundled into one installable `dsh-lfaa` artifact; users do not install the development workspace.

## Develop

```powershell
npm install --legacy-peer-deps --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm test
npm run check
```

The installable output is `dist/packages/dsh-lfaa/`. The build excludes private workspace dependencies, development source, test fixtures and user data. Install that output through DSH's official profile plugin command, not the repository root. The package is currently private and is not published by this workflow.

The current implementation contributes native workspace surfaces and the first interface-experience module. Other business capabilities are not defined or claimed. Read the [architecture](docs/architecture.md), [extension points](docs/extension-points.md), [development standard](DEVELOPMENT.md), [agent rules](AGENTS.md) and [actual validation](docs/validation.md).

plugins.description: 图灵圆桌：若干座位由不同模型配置的 agent 扮演，靠提问与交叉印证找出哪些座位是 AI，每局导出逐席位对话 JSONL 与判定记录
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-turing-table（图灵圆桌）

给 DeepSeek Harness 的**社交推理游戏**：一张桌上有 N 个座位，其中若干座位由**不同模型配置**的 agent 扮演，你要靠**提问**和**交叉印证**（同一个事实换着问、比较各座位的说法矛盾）找出哪些座位是 AI。每局导出**逐席位对话 JSONL**与**判定记录**，同一 seed + 同一份操作脚本可以复现出逐字节相同的对局。

## 为什么要有它

判断一个模型“像不像人”很难，但判断“两个座位里哪个在撒谎”是可玩的。这个插件把 DSH 里的一件事变得可测：**把不同 provider / model / system prompt / 说话风格的 agent 放进同一张桌子，让人在信息不对称下把它们分辨出来**，然后把整个过程落成可复查、可复现、可对比的文件。

这不是评测工具，是游戏。它的产品价值在于**对局记录**：换模型、换提示词、换伪装强度，同一批 seed 跑出来的 JSONL 可以直接 diff。

## 一局怎么玩

**座位与身份（seed 决定）**

- 座位数 `seatCount`（默认 6），其中 `humanSeats`（默认 1）个是人类座位，其余为 AI 座位。
- 座位身份在开局时由 seed 随机分配；人类座位里有一个是**你**（提问者，`player`），你不能判定自己坐的那个座位。
- **座位身份在判定前不会告诉客户端**：host 的 `/state` 里未判定座位的 `kind` 与 `modelConfig` 都是 `null`，判定之后才揭晓——揭晓时能看到该座位实际用的模型配置和伪装参数。

**每个 AI 座位绑定自己的模型配置**

配置来自插件配置项（不是写死的），每项是一个 `{ id, provider, model, temperature, system, style, voice, disguise }`：

- `provider` / `model` 为 `null` 时表示“跟随当前会话的模型”；填上就是真正不同的模型路由（host 会用**该座位自己的路由**发起这次调用，`test/host.test.mjs` 钉住了这一点）。
- 模型池会被 seed 洗牌后依次发给 AI 座位；池子不小于 AI 座位数时，每个座位拿到不同配置。
- 内置 6 个人格作为兜底（`archivist` / `barfly` / `hedger` / `mimic` / `contrarian` / `quiet`），`provider`/`model` 为 `null`。

**伪装强度（disguise）**

三档预设 `low` / `medium` / `high`，也可以逐项覆盖：

| 旋钮 | 作用 | low | medium | high |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `verbosity` | 回答长度预算（`terse`/`normal`/`chatty`，按句截断） | terse | normal | chatty |
| `colloquial` | 口语化：加语气词与软化尾 | 关 | 开（50%） | 开（70%） |
| `proactive` | 是否主动反问别的座位 | 关 | 关 | 开（45%） |
| `pressure` | **被追问时的策略** | concede | hold/concede | hold/deflect/escalate |

`pressure` 的四种策略在“同一事实第二次问同一个座位”时生效，这是本作的核心机制：

- `hold`：坚持原说法（`我再确认一下，…`）
- `deflect`：换一套说法并转移话题 → **会自相矛盾**，这是可以抓到的破绽
- `concede`：承认可能记错（`我可能记错了，…`）
- `escalate`：反问提问者或其他座位（`你怎么老问我这个？…`）

`high` 档会在候选池里按座位自己的随机流挑 `pressure`，所以两个“高伪装”座位不会表现成同一个人。

**一轮流程**

1. 你提问（`to: 'table'` 全桌依次回答，或点名某个座位）；
2. 座位按座位号依次回答，AI 座位的回答经过该座位的伪装策略整形（记录里同时保留 `raw` 原文与 `text` 整形后的话）；
3. 上一轮没答完时不能开新一轮（`unanswered`）；
4. **随时**可以对某个座位下判定（`这是 AI` / `这是人`），判定记录会记住它发生在第几轮——开局盲猜记为第 0 轮，收局之后也允许补判；
5. 全部可判定座位判完（`all-judged`）、你主动收局（`player-closed`）或达到 `maxRounds`（`max-rounds`）时结束。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-turing-table
```

装好后重启 DSH，对话视图里会出现「圆桌」Tab。（`lib/` 是入库的预构建产物，安装时不需要跑构建脚本，也没有任何依赖——`dependencies` 与 `devDependencies` 都是空的。）

## 配置

```jsonc
{
  "seed": "my-round-0001",      // 不给则用时间戳生成，并显示在面板上（对局仍会被完整记录）
  "seatCount": 6,
  "humanSeats": 1,              // 至少 1，且至少留一个 AI 座位
  "maxRounds": 8,
  "exportDir": "<默认 $DSH_HOME/turing-table>",
  "models": [
    { "id": "a", "provider": "deepseek", "model": "<model-id>", "temperature": 0.3,
      "system": "你话少、只说结论。", "style": "书面", "voice": "dry",
      "disguise": { "level": "low" } },
    { "id": "b", "provider": "deepseek", "model": "<another-model-id>", "temperature": 0.9,
      "system": "你爱闲聊。", "style": "口语化、话多", "voice": "warm",
      "disguise": { "level": "high", "pressure": "hold" } }
  ]
}
```

`models` 是**座位模型池**，不是座位表；谁拿到哪个由 seed 决定。

**单人默认配置的坦白话**：`humanSeats: 1` 时，除你之外所有座位都是 AI，于是“谁是 AI”在已知信息下等于全选。要让这一局真的有猜的成分，需要 ≥2 个人类座位——多人同桌（同一张桌上几个人各自输入），或者由外部驱动人类座位（host 的 `POST /say`，或脚本里的 `say` 步骤）。`examples/sample-spec.json` 就是一个 6 座 2 人的样例：4 个 AI、1 个人类座位（脚本喂台词）、外加你自己。

## 可复现性

座位分配、模型分配、伪装参数、离线回答、整形与时间戳**全部**来自 `src/rng.js` 的种子化随机与一个逻辑时钟：引擎里没有 `Math.random()`，也没有读真实时间。

- `createTable(spec)` 用同一份 spec 重建出完全相同的牌桌（`table.spec()` 就是那份 spec）；
- `runSpec(spec)` 用同一份 seed + 同一份操作脚本跑出**逐字节相同**的 JSONL 与判定记录（`test/cli.test.mjs` 直接拿它和入库的样例文件比字节）；
- 座位分配、模型分配、每个座位的伪装、每条消息的整形各自用**独立的随机子流**（`rng.fork()`），所以往一轮里多加一个问题是安全的：它不会把人重新洗一遍。

**什么是可复现的，什么不是**：牌桌、座位、顺序、prompt、整形、时间戳都可复现；**真实模型吐出的文本不可复现**——同一个 prompt 两次调用本来就不一样。用离线叙述者（`offlineResponder`）或罐头回答时，整局逐字节可复现。记录里 `raw` 与 `text` 并存，就是为了让“模型说了什么”和“伪装做了什么”分得开。

## 导出格式

一局导出两个文件（`examples/` 下的样例由 `node scripts/make-sample.mjs` 真实生成，不是手写）：

**1. 逐席位对话 JSONL**（`sample-round.jsonl`，每行一条自包含消息，LF 结尾、无 BOM）

```json
{"v":1,"seq":2,"id":"m0002","round":1,"ts":"2020-01-01T00:00:01.000Z","seat":1,"seatLabel":"座位 2","seatKind":"ai","role":"answer","to":0,"replyTo":"m0001","topic":"umbrella","modelConfig":{"id":"demo-blunt","provider":"demo-provider","model":"demo-model-d","temperature":0.8,"style":"直接，偶尔反问","voice":"blunt"},"disguise":{"level":"medium","verbosity":"normal","colloquial":true,"proactive":false,"colloquialRate":0.5,"proactiveRate":0,"pressure":"escalate"},"pressure":null,"shaped":true,"degraded":false,"applied":["colloquial:softener"],"raw":"这有啥好问的，应该是我带了伞。","text":"这有啥好问的，应该是我带了伞哈哈。","table":{"seed":"turing-sample-0001","seatCount":6,"humanSeats":2,"aiSeats":4}}
```

| 字段 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `v` / `seq` / `id` | 记录版本、行序号、消息 id（`m0001`…） |
| `round` / `ts` | 第几轮、逻辑时间戳（`startedAt + seq × stepMs`） |
| `seat` / `seatLabel` / `seatKind` | 座位号、显示名、`ai` 或 `human`（真值，供事后分析；客户端在判定前看不到） |
| `role` | `question`（提问者）或 `answer`（座位） |
| `to` / `replyTo` | 这条回答回应哪条消息、提问指向谁（`"table"` 或座位号） |
| `topic` | 事实话题键（内置词表命中，或 `q-<hash>`） |
| `modelConfig` | 该座位这次发言用的模型配置摘要（人类座位为 `null`） |
| `disguise` | 该座位当轮的伪装参数（人类座位为 `null`） |
| `pressure` | 这次回答触发哪种被追问策略（没触发为 `null`） |
| `shaped` / `applied` | 是否经过整形、整形动作清单 |
| `degraded` | 模型失败/缺路由时降级为离线回答的标记 |
| `raw` / `text` | 模型（或人）原始输出 / 整形后真正说出口的话 |
| `table` | 牌桌身份（seed、座位数、人类数），使每一行单看也成立 |

**2. 判定记录**（`sample-verdicts.json`）

`truth`（座位→真值）、`seats[]`（含是否被判定、判定值、对错、判定发生在第几轮、该座位用的模型配置与伪装参数）、`verdicts[]`（判定流水，含时间戳）、`score`（`total` / `judged` / `correct` / `wrong` / `accuracy` = 判对 ÷ 已判 / `coverage` = 已判 ÷ 总数 / `unjudged`）、`endReason`（`all-judged` / `player-closed` / `max-rounds`）。

## 命令

```sh
node scripts/make-sample.mjs                       # 重新生成 examples/（逐字节稳定）
node scripts/export.mjs examples/sample-spec.json  # 跑一遍 spec，导出 JSONL + 判定记录
node scripts/export.mjs --replay examples/sample-round.jsonl
node scripts/export.mjs --verify examples/sample-round.jsonl --verdicts examples/sample-verdicts.json
```

`export.mjs` 也接受 `table.exportRound()` 产出的对局记录（`{kind:'turing-table-round', spec, events, verdicts}`）。**导出前会先自检**（JSONL 可解析、字段齐全、真值与判定一致、分数能对上），自检不过就一个字节都不写。

## 开发

```sh
node scripts/build.mjs   # 零依赖构建：src/ -> lib/
node --test              # 98 个用例
```

`src/` 是手写源码，`lib/` 与 `examples/` 是产物，两者都入库；改 `src/` 后必须重新 `build`（`test/build.test.mjs` 会逐字节比对 `lib/` 与 `src/`，忘记构建会直接红）。

测试覆盖：种子化随机（同种子同序列、子流互不干扰）、伪装预设与逐座位解析、模型池分发、事实记忆与交叉印证、每个 `pressure` 策略的可观测差别、牌桌流程与全部错误码、判定与计分、JSONL 自包含与不可复原记录的拒绝、host 路由与**逐座位模型路由**、四种降级路径、卸载拆除路由、client 半区在 `__ModuleLoader__` 下的加载/渲染/提交/轮询清理、样例逐字节复现、CLI 的正常与错误路径。

## 参考了什么，以及不同在哪

- **骨架**照抄自本机另一个 DSH 插件项目 `dsh-warden` 的结构：`src/` 手写 + `scripts/build.mjs` 零依赖构建到 `lib/`、host 半区 ESM（`lib/index.js` 导出 `name` / `inject` / `apply`）、client 半区 CJS 由 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load()` 包裹、`cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert` 行、`package.json` 里的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 与 `dsh.client`、README 的章节顺序、以及“路由注册失败也要保住核心功能”的失败策略。只借了**骨架与模式**，没有搬运它的代码，方向也完全不同（那是危险工具调用的审查门，这里是社交推理游戏）。
- 按 Lead 转述，开源世界里存在邻近方向的公开项目（例如线索 `9931666/dsh-plugin-roundtable`）。**我没有核实过它的实现细节，也没有使用它的代码**，它只作为“这条方向有人在做”的旁证。
- 与 warden 的具体不同：多了 `src/table.js`（游戏引擎）、`src/rng.js`（种子化随机）、`src/facts.js`（共享事实）、`src/speaker.js`（prompt + 离线叙述者 + 伪装整形）、`src/export.js`（JSONL / 判定记录的读写与校验）、`scripts/export.mjs`（CLI）、`examples/`（真实生成的对局样例）；没有 `devDependencies`（warden 里那份 esbuild 依赖这里不需要）。

## 它不做什么 / 未验证的部分

- **没在真实 DSH 运行时里跑过**：host 半区的路由、llm 调用与卸载路径都是对着 stub 验证的，`ctx.get('llm')` 的流式分片形状按 warden 的用法推断；client 半区在 `node:vm` + 假 React 下加载渲染，**没有在真实 Web GUI 里加载过**。
- **不接真实模型也能玩**：没有 `llm` 服务或缺路由时自动降级到离线叙述者，并在消息上标 `degraded: true`——离线叙述者只会照内置话题词表（伞/值班/咖啡/钥匙/午饭/通勤/电梯/宠物）记忆事实，**自由措辞的问题在离线模式下不能交叉印证**，那种场景要靠真实模型。
- **不是评测基准**：`score` 只反映这一局玩家的判断，样本量是一局，别拿它当模型能力的证据。
- **不碰你的本机配置**：默认导出目录是 `$DSH_HOME/turing-table/`，只在点击「导出这一局」时写入；测试一律用临时目录。

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-windows-monitor

English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

[![CI](https://github.com/joyboy-yy/dsh-windows-monitor/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/joyboy-yy/dsh-windows-monitor/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

A system monitor overlay for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): a compact pill in the bottom-right corner showing live CPU and memory, expanding into a detail card with disk activity and throughput, per-volume capacity, network state, uptime and battery.

Runs on **Windows**.

![Collapsed and expanded states](https://unpkg.com/dsh-windows-monitor/docs/preview.png)

## Features

- **Never covers the middle.** Collapsed it is a ~210 px pill; expanded it is a 280 px card. It sits clear of the composer by default.
- **Draggable.** Drag the pill or the card header anywhere; the position is clamped to the viewport and remembered. A reset control returns it to the corner.
- **Live at a glance.** The status dot is colour-coded — green nominal, amber elevated, pulsing red for collection failure.
- **Detail on demand.** CPU, memory and **disk activity** as bars, plus one row per volume, a memory total, adapter state, uptime and battery.
- **Capacity and activity are never conflated.** The 磁盘 gauge is *busy time* — the same figure as Task Manager's own 磁盘 column, computed as `100 − PercentIdleTime`. Fullness is a separate per-volume row. A static "93% full" number sitting next to a live CPU reading reads as a stuck or broken dial, so it is never what the gauge shows.
- **Unknown is a real state.** Disk activity is best-effort: with no performance-counter provider, or before the first sample, the panel renders `--` rather than `0%`. A zero would be a claim about an idle disk that nothing actually measured.
- **Honest failure states.** A failed collection shows "unavailable" in the pill instead of stale numbers; a platform with no collector says so explicitly rather than looking broken.
- **Theme-native.** Every colour is a DSH theme token, so light and dark mode follow the app. Icons are inline SVG from the harness's own icon set — no icon fonts.
- **Accessible.** Real buttons with labels, visible focus rings, and animations disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the **Web** profile and the current profile-bundle system.
- **Windows.** The host process must be running on Windows; see [Platform support](#platform-support).
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (to build from source).

No administrator rights are needed, and nothing is installed system-wide.

## Platform support

Windows only, and that is deliberate. The plugin is named for Windows, its headline reading (disk activity) comes from a Windows performance counter, and a collector the maintainer cannot run is a collector whose bugs they cannot reproduce. Shipping Linux and macOS collectors that were written from documentation — and that the author could never exercise on their own hardware — traded a promise the project could not keep for two code paths it could not maintain.

The host picks the collector from `process.platform`, never from the request.

| Platform | Collector |
|---|---|
| **Windows** | PowerShell + CIM/WMI (`Win32_Processor`, `Win32_OperatingSystem`, `Win32_LogicalDisk`, `Win32_Battery`, `Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfDisk_PhysicalDisk`) and `Get-NetAdapter`. Verified by the author on Windows 11 |
| **Anything else** | None. The route answers `501` with an explicit unsupported-platform body, and the panel renders that instead of empty gauges |

`linux` and `macOS` collectors did ship in `0.1.0`; they were removed in `0.2.0`. See the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md).

CI still runs on all three runners, and that is also deliberate. `windows-latest` exercises the collector for real, while `ubuntu-latest` and `macos-latest` prove the negative contract: with no collector the plugin must answer the error rather than pretend. See [`.github/workflows/ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml).

Known limitations:

- Disk activity needs the Windows performance-counter provider. On a host where it is disabled or missing, the reading degrades to `--` instead of failing the snapshot.
- The collector pins the process culture to invariant. The fact format is `key=value` with `.` as the decimal separator, so a comma-decimal locale would otherwise emit unparseable numbers.
- Some drivers report `PercentDiskTime` several times above 100, which is why busy time is derived from the idle complement instead.

## Install

From npm — prebuilt, and the only path that needs no build permission:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-windows-monitor
```

From a local checkout — this is the path to use while developing:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add D:\path\to\dsh-windows-monitor
dsh --profile web --dump-config   # confirm the windows-monitor row is composed
dsh --profile web
```

From a release tarball (prebuilt, no build permission needed):

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add .\dsh-windows-monitor-<version>.tgz
```

From a pinned source tag — see [releases](https://github.com/joyboy-yy/dsh-windows-monitor/releases) for the current one:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:joyboy-yy/dsh-windows-monitor#v0.2.1
```

A git install fetches source and runs this package's `prepare` build, which means package code executes on your machine outside the agent sandbox. pnpm refuses that until the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` explicitly allows it:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  dsh-windows-monitor: true
```

Read the source and pin a tag before granting that. A release tarball ships prebuilt files and needs no such permission.

## Configuration

This bundle inserts one Host/Client row, declared in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: windows-monitor
      name: dsh-windows-monitor
      inject: [shell, sandboxPolicy, webServer]
```

Override that row in your profile or home `cordis.patch.yml` to disable it or change its position in the tree.

Browser-local preferences are limited to one value: the dragged panel position, stored under the `dsh-windows-monitor:position` `localStorage` key. It is written only when you drag the panel and removed when you press reset. The plugin stores no metrics.

## How it works

The **Host half** registers one read-only route and runs the collector for its own platform through the harness `shell` service:

```
GET /api/windows-monitor/snapshot
```

The collector prints one `key=value` fact per line. A line format — rather than JSON — is deliberate: emitting correct JSON from PowerShell without assuming a JSON library is a portability trap, whereas `key=value` is trivial to produce and trivial to parse (and unit-test) on the TypeScript side. The host converts facts into the snapshot the client renders and stamps the timestamp itself.

The shell seam is driven through **both** of its entry points. DSH renamed `ctx.shell.run(spec)` to `ctx.shell.execute(spec)`, which resolves with a handle whose `result()` carries the outcome, so the host prefers `execute` and falls back to `run`. Hard-coding either one breaks the plugin on the harness versions that expose the other — `0.2.3` did exactly that and answered every poll with `ctx.shell.run is not a function`. `tests/collectors.test.ts` now covers both, plus a seam with neither.

Results are cached for 5 seconds, and concurrent polls share a single in-flight collection instead of racing, so the browser's polling never multiplies collector runs.

The **Client half** registers into the frame-wide `shell.overlay` slot. That layer is click-through by design — the panel opts into pointer events, so it never blocks the app underneath.

Neither half touches the model, the session, or the transcript. The plugin registers no tools.

## Security model

Read this before installing.

- **The collector is read-only.** It reads CIM/WMI and runs `Get-NetAdapter`. Nothing writes, installs, or changes machine state.
- **The sandbox grant is broad.** The Host half resolves the `danger-full-access` sandbox policy so the shell ca

plugins.description: DSH 模型探测插件：用已存凭据查询厂商实时模型目录，预览后经官方配置编辑器安全写回。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH 模型探测 · 0.1.0

在「设置 → 模型探测」中用 Host 已存 API key 查询厂商模型列表，与当前模型列表比较，然后通过官方配置编辑器预览、确认并采用。**列出模型不等于账号具备推理权限；本插件不调用推理接口。**

已验证环境：Windows，DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`，Cordis `4.0.4`，pi-ai `0.87.1`；内嵌 Node `24.18.1` 和普通 Node `24.21.0`。其他 DSH 版本尚未验证。

## 为什么不是点一下“获取可用模型”

官方页面当前读取的是运行时模型服务目录，而不是每次重新访问厂商 `/models`。pi-ai 随包携带静态目录；账户能用的模型、厂商实时目录和这个快照并不等价。只刷新页面不会更新包内目录。本插件不替换官方「模型」页、不修改 DSH 核心，也不把缺失模型自动删除。

## v1 支持范围

| 类型 | 模型列表请求 | 能力与限制 |
|---|---|---|
| Google Generative AI | `{base}/models?pageSize=1000`，`x-goog-api-key` | 仅保留 `generateContent`；读取厂商上下文/输出上限，不凭模型名推测图片能力 |
| OpenAI completions / responses、兼容网关 | `{base}/models`，Bearer API key | 标准 `data[]`，以及兼容的 `models[]` / `models{ID:信息}`；未知形状拒绝解析 |
| Anthropic Messages | `{base}/v1/models?limit=1000`，`x-api-key` + `anthropic-version` | 列表解析；未提供的容量留空或按下述来源补全 |
| OpenRouter | `{base}/models` | 可直接查询；也可显式勾选匿名参数补全 |
| OpenAI Codex OAuth | **不查询** | v1 只显示本地登录记录状态并手填模型参数；未验证发现端点，不能声称一键同步或查询成功 |
| 其他协议 | 不猜测 | 手填；兼容代理可显式选择已支持协议与地址后再查询 |

只取一页；识别到 `nextPageToken` / `has_more` 会标记列表可能不完整。不会自动翻页。空列表、认证失败、超时、格式不兼容不是删除现有模型的理由。

参数逐字段优先级：**厂商响应 > 同 provider 精确 ID 的内置目录 > 用户开启的匿名 OpenRouter 精确 ID 估算 > 手填 > 省略**。界面标注来源；不做跨厂商模糊匹配。用户在手填表中主动修订的值按手填内容采用。

## 使用

1. 先在官方「模型」页配置凭据或登录。插件没有 API key / token 输入框。
2. 打开「设置 → 模型探测」。普通 API 路由可查询，Codex 只有状态及手填区。
3. 查询不写配置。对兼容代理改地址会先提示是否向该地址发送当前路由的凭据；仅本次查询生效，不保存地址。
4. 勾选模型，或「载入勾选结果并修订」。手填区默认载入当前声明，支持 ID、名称、上下文、输出上限和 text/image 输入模态。数值必须是正整数；未知时留空。
5. 点「预览写入」，检查新增、移除、完整前后模型字段和来源。**采用是整体替换该路由列表，不是自动追加；要保留的旧模型必须仍在列表内。**
6. 再点「确认写入 profile」并确认弹窗。预览五分钟有效，单次使用；换选择、改手填内容或配置版本变化后需重新预览。
7. 「恢复内置目录」删除显式 `models` 键，绝不写成空数组；「查看模型备份」可预览并确认恢复目标路由的旧模型字段。

Codex 状态只区分缺记录、结构不支持、记录过期、读取失败或本地记录看似有效。**看似有效不等于在线授权或推理权限有效**。过期/缺记录请到官方「模型 → OpenAI Codex」重新登录；插件不刷新、不修改、也不发送 OAuth access/refresh token 或 account ID。

## 配置与安全边界

- Host 唯一写入入口为官方 `configEditor.edit`，锁内再次核对 revision；不自行拼接 YAML，不旁路写 profile。
- 仅改 `llm-pi-ai` 目标 provider 的 `models` / `modelOverrides`。采用显式列表时会先在预览中提示清除不兼容的旧 overrides，并将其备份。默认模型、其他路由、地址、凭据引用不变。
- 备份在 profile 的 `.model-probe-backups` 目录，只保存目标路由的白名单模型字段，不复制整份 YAML 或凭据。全局保留最近五份合法备份；成功和失败写入都尝试轮换。磁盘清理失败会明确提示，可能暂时超过五份；无关/损坏文件不擅自删除。
- 备份创建失败则不调用官方编辑器。备份含无法安全、无损保存的额外字段时拒绝写入，而不是静默截断。
- API key 仅在 Host 读取并发给用户确认的目标服务；禁用重定向，错误不回显响应正文、请求头或底层异常。已知本次 key 若被厂商回显到可展示字段则拒绝返回；这不构成任意编码/任意第三方敏感内容的 DLP 保证。
- 默认只允许 HTTPS；HTTP 仅允许 `localhost`、`127.0.0.1`、`[::1]`。地址禁止用户名、密码、查询参数和 fragment。用户仍须自行确认 HTTPS 自定义服务可信；不是全面的网络隔离/SSRF 沙箱。
- 默认 20 秒超时；响应及单份备份最大 4 MiB；列表最多 10000 项；支持取消和卸载释放。不自动刷新、不后台轮询。
- OpenRouter 参数补全默认关闭；开启后发独立匿名请求，不携带当前厂商 key，不上传模型列表或提示词；只在 Host 用精确 ID 对照，失败保留原厂商结果。
- Client/Host 协议版本不一致及 404/405 有完整重启提示。配置保存与热更新验证分别报告；保存成功后核对失败不会谎报“未保存”。

## 安装与升级

**必须先得到用户对当前 profile 安装/启用的明确确认。** 两条路：

- **npm（普通用户）**：设置 → 插件 → 添加插件，填包名 `dsh-live-model-probe`（或 `dsh-live-model-probe@0.1.0` 锁定版本）。包名是 `dsh-live-model-probe`；仓库仍叫 [`lyufeng000/dsh-model-probe`](https://github.com/lyufeng000/dsh-model-probe)，npm 上原有的 `dsh-model-probe` 是别的作者的另一个插件，**不要**用这个名字。
- **本地源码（开发）**：源码根目录作为 `link:<绝对源码目录>` 依赖登记。

### 本地源码安装（开发用）

- bundle 为 `dsh-live-model-probe`，通过包内 patch 挂载 `model-probe`，Host 条目 ID 为 `include:model-probe`。不要再在 profile patch 中重复 insert。
- 安装前备份相关 profile 文件；通过官方插件管理器处理本地 bundle，检查依赖/锁文件仅作增量改动，不运行未经同意的构建脚本。
- 同步插件治理账本、校验 JSON/YAML；本插件源码不放到治理目录或 DSH 安装目录中。
- 安装/Host 更新后由用户**完全退出并重新打开 DSH**，不只是刷新页面。代理不得自停当前宿主。模型配置正常保存并验证热更新成功时则不需要重启。
- 本地 `link:` 依赖改源码即生效（Host 仍需完全重启）；npm 来源则要换版本重装。官方插件管理器目前**没有自动更新**，升级需卸载后重新安装。

## 测试复现（PowerShell，源码根目录）

普通 Node 单元测试（五项 DSH 集成测试在缺少 runtime 变量时跳过）：

```powershell
$env:DSH_MODEL_TEST_ROOT = '<临时工作目录>'
node --test test/*.test.mjs
```

真实 DSH 集成测试，用实际安装路径替换以下变量。`DSH_MODEL_TEST_READ_PROFILE` **只读**，测试创建独立 Include/临时 profile，不写这个 profile。

```powershell
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = '1'
$env:DSH_MODEL_TEST_RUNTIME = '<DSH 安装目录>\resources\app.asar\dsh'
$env:DSH_MODEL_TEST_ROOT = '<临时工作目录>'
$env:DSH_MODEL_TEST_READ_PROFILE = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop"
& '<DSH 安装目录>\DeepSeek Harness.exe' --expose-internals --test --test-isolation=none test/*.test.mjs
```

真实浏览器测试复用这些变量，另可用 `DSH_MODEL_TEST_BROWSER` 指定 Chrome 可执行文件；默认 Windows Chrome 安装位置。测试开独立临时 profile 和 port 0 HTTP 服务，使用合成厂商响应，不使用真实 OAuth/API key；运行完释放临时 Host/浏览器，不替换当前 GUI。

```powershell
& '<DSH 安装目录>\DeepSeek Harness.exe' --expose-internals scripts/browser-smoke.mjs
```

测试需要 Electron ASAR 环境和 Chrome；普通 Node 不能代替 ASAR 集成运行器。临时输出在 `DSH_MODEL_TEST_ROOT`，截图/结果位置打印到日志；可复现的入口是 `scripts/browser-smoke.mjs`（历史验收脚本未随本仓库发布）。

## 验收证据与尚未验证

本轮开发的 P0–P5 验收报告、界面截图与测试/冒烟输出保存在作者本地，**未随本仓库发布**；下面列出仍然成立与尚未验证的边界。

未验证：所有厂商的真实账号、模型推理权限、Codex 在线模型发现、真实 ACL 拒绝写入、断电/磁盘满、真实原子替换失败后的系统恢复。备份目录不可用已用“同名普通文件”故障注入验证，不冒充 ACL 测试；官方 schema/overlay 拒绝和真实热更新另有集成证据。不能把隔离测试通过称为用户当前桌面已安装验收。

plugins.description: OpenAI-compatible local proxy exposing Qoder CN credits as a /v1/chat/completions API, plus a DSH model-provider plugin
plugins.readme_text:
# qoder-proxy — 把 Qoder 积分变成 OpenAI 兼容 API

> 📘 English documentation: [README.en.md](./README.en.md)

用 Qoder CN 的账号积分跑任意 OpenAI 兼容客户端（DSH、Cline、Continue、各种 SDK）。

**已验证可用**：15 个模型、流式/非流式、思考链（`reasoning_content`）、逐次积分计量。

---

## 它是什么

```
你的客户端 ──OpenAI API──> qoder-proxy (127.0.0.1:8317) ──官方 SDK──> Qoder CN
                                  │
                                  └─ 每次请求返回消耗的积分
```

反代**不碰** Qoder 的私有协议，而是驱动官方 npm SDK
（`@qodercn-ai/qodercn-agent-sdk`）。SDK 内部带着完整的 worker runtime，
签名、加密、设备指纹都由官方代码处理——所以**Qoder 侧看到的是一次正常的官方请求**，
不存在自己实现签名导致的封号风险，也不需要每次客户端更新就修一遍。

积分从**同一个账号**扣，就是你在 Qoder 设置页看到的那个数字。

---

## 快速开始

### 0. 安装

```bash
git clone <this-repo> && cd qoder-proxy
npm install
```

> `npm install` 会拉下 `@qodercn-ai/qodercn-agent-sdk`，其中含一个约 33MB 的
> worker runtime。它必须完整存在，不要用 `--omit=optional` 之类的方式裁剪。

### 1. 登录（只需一次）

```bash
npm run setup        # 等价于下面的手动命令；打开浏览器确认即完成
```

`setup` 会调用 Qoder 官方 SDK 自带的设备码登录，用**你自己的账号**完成认证，
凭据进入系统凭据管理器（Windows 上是 `qoder-cli-cn-oauth`），**不会**写进任何明文文件。

> 手动方式（当 setup 不可用）：
> ```bash
> npx qodercn login
> # 或 node node_modules/@qodercn-ai/qodercn-agent-sdk/dist/_worker/qoder-worker-runtime.obf.mjs login
> ```
> 浏览器里确认 `https://qoder.cn/device/selectAccounts?...` 链接即可。

验证：

```bash
npx qodercn --list-models   # 应列出 15 个模型
```

### 2. 起反代

```bash
npm start
```

默认监听 `http://127.0.0.1:8317`。

### 3. 用

```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8317/v1/models

curl -s -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"DeepSeek-V4-Pro","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"你好"}]}' \
  http://127.0.0.1:8317/v1/chat/completions
```

---

## 端点

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/v1/models` | 15 个模型 |
| POST | `/v1/chat/completions` | 支持 `stream: true` |
| GET | `/health` | 健康检查 |

流式是标准 SSE，结尾有 `data: [DONE]`。

### 响应里的积分

非流式：`qoder_credits` 字段 + `x-qoder-credits` 响应头

```json
{
  "choices": [{"message": {"role":"assistant","content":"PONG",
               "reasoning_content":"The user asks..."}}],
  "qoder_credits": 0.12933373199999998
}
```

流式：最后一个 chunk 带 `usage: {"credits": 0.139...}`

> **关于 token 数**：Qoder 后端按积分计费，**不返回真实 token 数**。
> 反代会在后端返回 0 时按字符数估算并标记 `estimated_tokens: true`，
> 这样客户端（如 DSH 的用量徽章）不至于显示 0。

### 思考链

模型有思考过程时，会放在 `reasoning_content` 里（流式和非流式都支持）。
这是 DeepSeek / OpenAI SDK 生态的通用字段，客户端一般会自动渲染。

---

## 环境变量

| 变量 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `QODER_PROXY_PORT` | `8317` | 监听端口 |
| `QODER_PROXY_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | 监听地址（默认仅本机） |
| `QODER_PROXY_MODEL` | `Auto` | 客户端没指定 model 时用哪个 |
| `QODER_PROXY_API_KEY` | 空 | 设了就要 `Authorization: Bearer <key>` |

---

## 可用模型

```
Auto · Fast
Qwen3.8-Max · Qwen3.8-Flash · Qwen3.7-Max · Qwen3.7-Plus · Qwen3.7-Flash
DeepSeek-V4-Pro · DeepSeek-Flash
GLM-5.3 · GLM-5.3-Flash · GLM-5.2
Kimi-K3 · Kimi-K2.8-Preview
MiniMax-M2.7
```

名不对时会自动容错：`deepseek-v4-pro` → `DeepSeek-V4-Pro`，含 `flash`/`fast` → `Fast`。

---

## 接到 DSH

仓库里的 `dsh-plugin/` 是一个 DSH 模型 provider 插件，把上面的端点注册成 DSH provider：

一条命令即可完成挂载（自动建 junction + 追加 patch 条目，幂等）：

```bash
npm run install:dsh          # 等价于 node install-dsh-plugin.mjs
# 可选：指定 profile / DSH_HOME
DSH_PROFILE=web DSH_HOME=/path/to/.dsh node install-dsh-plugin.mjs
```

手动方式：

1. 把 `dsh-plugin/` 挂进你的 DSH profile（例如用 junction / symlink 放到
   `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-llm-qoder`，或直接 `dsh plugin add` 该目录）；
2. 在 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加：

   ```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: llm-qoder
         name: dsh-llm-qoder
   ```

3. 重启 DSH。

之后：

- provider id：`qoder`，显示名 `Qoder CN`
- 15 个模型出现在模型选择器里
- 改 provider 设置（baseUrl / 显示名 / 开关键）改 `dsh-plugin/index.js` 里的 `Config` 默认值，
  或在 DSH 设置界面里覆盖。

**注意**：反代必须先在 8317 上跑着；否则模型列表能出来，但一发请求就 502。

---

## 接到其它客户端

任何 OpenAI 兼容客户端都能用：

- **Base URL**：`http://127.0.0.1:8317/v1`
- **API Key**：随便填（除非设了 `QODER_PROXY_API_KEY`）
- **Model**：见上表

---

## 已知限制

- **无状态**：每次请求都重新拼完整对话发给模型。这意味着没有服务端会话缓存，
  好处是任何客户端都能接、不会串话。代价是长对话的 prompt 处理成本略高。
- **不支持 function calling**：SDK 的 `allowedTools: []` 关掉了工具调用，
  所以 `tools` 参数会被忽略。DSH 的 agent 能力依赖它自己的工具循环，
  模型侧只需要能返回文本——这一点是满足的。
- **单账号串行**：反代本身可以并发，但积分是同一个账号的总额度。
- **依赖 worker runtime**：`node_modules/@qodercn-ai/qodercn-agent-sdk` 里的
  33MB worker runtime 必须完整存在。

---

## 排错

**`No qodercli login found`**
→ 还没登录，跑第 1 步。

**模型列表有，但请求 502**
→ 反代进程没起，或者 Qoder 凭据过期。看反代 stderr 里的具体报错。

**积分没变 / 一直是 0**
→ 检查 `qoder_credits` 字段是否非零。免费额度用尽时 Qoder 会返回错误，检查 stderr。

**重启后 DSH 里没有 `qoder` provider**
→ 看 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 里有没有 `- id: llm-qoder`，
  然后看 DSH 启动日志有没有 `dsh-llm-qoder: registered provider`。

---

## `dev/` 目录

逆向过程中的探针脚本，保留作为可复现证据，**不参与运行时**：

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `dev/t1-auth.mjs` | 验证 SDK 认证是否可用（对比实验：故意 import Global 版 SDK，证明它看不到 CN 版登录态） |
| `dev/t2-cn.mjs` | 确认走的是 CN 版配置目录（`.qoder-cn` 而非 `.qoder`） |
| `dev/t3-chat.mjs` | 非流式对话冒烟测试 |
| `dev/t4-stream.mjs` | 流式对话冒烟测试 |
| `dev/t5-usage.mjs` | **关键探针**：证明 Qoder 后端不回真实 token 数、只回积分 |

> 这些探针**需要本机已登录的 Qoder 凭据**才能跑，仅供开发参考，不参与运行时。

---

MIT

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus `~/.qoder` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `.qoder/rules/` | | `hermes` | `~/.hermes/memories/` (`MEMORY.md` + `USER.md`) and the global `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | - The `source` argument selects one tool, or omit it to run every source enabled in settings. - The `path` argument selects the workspace root for project-scoped files
