plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

# dsh-memory — DSH 长期记忆插件

[DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的持久化长期记忆插件：
**多套 OpenAI 兼容云端嵌入 provider + Qdrant 向量库**，自动记录对话要点、自动召回相关记忆，
并提供 `memory_search` / `memory_save` / `memory_forget` 工具与完整的设置页 GUI。

纯 JavaScript，无构建依赖（Host 半用 `build.mjs` 拼成单文件），唯一运行时依赖是 DSH 自带的
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`。

![概览](docs/screenshots/overview.png)

## 功能

- **多 provider 档案**：可保存多套云端服务商配置并随时切换激活项，不再绑定硅基流动。
  内置预设：硅基流动、OpenAI、阿里云百炼（DashScope 兼容模式）、智谱 BigModel、火山方舟 Ark、
  Jina AI、Voyage AI、自定义 OpenAI 兼容服务。
  每个 provider 独立配置：Base URL、嵌入模型、向量维度、Key 引用名、是否发送 `dimensions`、
  视觉模型（用于图片概览）、视觉接口 Base URL / Key 引用名。
- **设置页直接填 API Key**：Key 写入 DSH 凭据库（`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`），
  不写进插件配置文件，也不会回传到浏览器；支持按 provider 设置/清除、状态徽标。
- **自动记录**：每轮对话结束后，把「用户要点 + 助手回答要点」写入 Qdrant（不额外调用大模型）；
  可按 `captureMinChars` 过滤“好的/谢谢”之类噪音。
- **图片记忆**：用户发图时调用 provider 的视觉模型生成**一句话概览**，只存这句话 + 向量，
  **永不保存原图**；也支持只记占位或完全忽略图片。
- **自动召回**：每轮第一步检索相关历史记忆，以 `source=long-term-memory` 的上下文行注入
  （DSH 会渲染为“上下文注入”，不是用户气泡）；可配置条数、最低相关度、字符上限、超时、是否包含当前会话。
- **记忆范围**：`global` 全局共享 / `workspace` 按工作目录隔离 / `session` 按会话隔离。
- **记忆管理**：设置页里语义搜索、按时间浏览、手动添加、删除、导出 JSON、重建集合。
- **定期维护**：按间隔自动执行（也可点「立即维护」）：
  清理超过保留天数的记忆、淘汰超出条数上限的最旧记忆、合并高度相似的重复记忆、重建 payload 索引。
- **时间与时区（v0.3）**：时间戳按 epoch 存储，显示时使用你选择的时区（默认跟随服务器本地）。
  自动召回上下文会附带「当前时间（含时区）」与每条记忆的相对时间（如“3 天前”），方便模型判断新旧；
  记忆管理页支持按「今天 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天」筛选。
- **模型工具**：`memory_search` / `memory_save` / `memory_forget`，可在设置页一键禁用；
  写入前自动脱敏（`sk-…`、`Bearer …`、`api_key: …`、`password: …` 等）。

| Provider 档案 | 记忆管理 |
|---|---|
| ![Provider](docs/screenshots/providers.png) | ![记忆管理](docs/screenshots/memory-manager.png) |

## 安装

### 方式一：从 GitHub 安装（推荐）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:krutziy/dsh-memory
```

装好后刷新浏览器页面，进入 **设置 → 长期记忆** 配置 provider 与 API Key。

### 方式二：本地目录安装（开发）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-memory
```

新装插件通常由 DSH 的 HMR 直接激活；浏览器端设置页需要刷新一次页面。

## 配置说明

设置页分为五个 Tab：

### 概览
显示当前激活 provider、API Key 状态、Qdrant 连接与版本、集合条数/维度、记忆范围、工具开关、
最近写入/召回、最近维护结果、后台队列。

### 模型与向量库

| 配置 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| Provider 档案 | 多套服务商配置，选择一个「当前激活」。切换后新写入/检索立即使用新 provider |
| Base URL | 需支持 OpenAI 兼容的 `POST /embeddings`（以及视觉概览用的 `/chat/completions`） |
| 嵌入模型 | 该服务商的 embedding 模型名 |
| 向量维度 | 必须与模型实际输出一致，并与 Qdrant 集合一致；改维度后需「重建集合」 |
| Key 引用名 | 凭据在 DSH 凭据库中的引用名，留空默认 `<ID>_API_KEY`；设置页下方直接填 Key |
| 视觉模型 | 图片概览使用的多模态模型；留空则图片只记占位 |
| 发送 dimensions | 部分服务不支持 `dimensions` 参数时关闭 |
| Qdrant 地址/集合 | 默认 `http://127.0.0.1:6333` / `dsh_memory`；Qdrant 有鉴权时填 Key 引用名 |

### 记忆行为
记忆范围、自动记录/召回开关、召回条数/相关度/字符上限/超时、图片记忆方式与提示词、工具开关与默认条数。

### 时间与时区
| 配置 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 时区 | 跟随服务器本地 | 记忆显示时间、相对时间、召回上下文里的“当前时间”都按该时区；提供常见 IANA 时区下拉，也支持填自定义 IANA 名称 |
| 召回时附带当前时间 | 开 | 自动召回时在上下文里写明当前时间（含时区），便于模型判断记忆新旧 |
| 显示相对时间 | 开 | 在召回内容与记忆列表中显示“3 小时前 / 2 天前” |

![时间与时区](docs/screenshots/time-timezone.png)

### 记忆管理
记忆列表（语义搜索/时间筛选/分页/删除）、手动添加、导出 JSON、定期维护与保留策略、重建集合。

### 高级
记录时的用户/助手内容截断字符、最短记录字符、是否记录子代理会话、调试日志。

## 数据与安全

- Qdrant 中每条记忆只包含：脱敏后的文本要点、类型、时间、会话 id、工作目录、provider、向量。
  图片只保留概览与宽高/格式，**不保存图片字节**。
- API Key 保存在 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`（`refs` 映射），不进入插件配置/profile patch。
- DSH 自己的会话日志本来就会保存聊天图片附件，这与本插件无关。
- 建议 Qdrant 只监听 `127.0.0.1`；如需远程访问请配置 API Key 与安全组，不要直接暴露公网。
- 插件不会回填历史会话；从安装后开始记录。

## 开发与热重载

- 源码：`src/index.js`（Host 入口）、`src/lib/*.js`（各模块）；`client.js` 是浏览器设置页（单文件，无构建）。
- DSH 的 HMR 在 Node 26 下只刷新入口模块，因此 Host 半用构建脚本拼成无本地 import 的单文件 `index.js`：

  ```sh
  node build.mjs
  ```

  写回 `index.js` 后，若 profile 里开启了 HMR 模块监听，会自动重载插件，无需重启 dsh：
  在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 里加入：

  ```yaml
  - id: hmr
    name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-hmr"
    config:
      base: "/"
      root:
        - home/ubuntu/mem/dsh-memory
  ```

  修改 `client.js` 后刷新浏览器一次即可。

## 本地 HTTP 接口（设置页同源，仅供排查/扩展）

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/__dsh_memory__/status` | 运行状态 |
| GET | `/__dsh_memory__/memories?q=&limit=&offset=&kind=` | 记忆列表/语义搜索 |
| GET | `/__dsh_memory__/export` | 导出全部记忆 JSON |
| POST | `/__dsh_memory__/test` | 测试激活 provider（可带 `{providerId}`） |
| POST | `/__dsh_memory__/memories` | 手动添加 `{text,kind,tags}` |
| POST | `/__dsh_memory__/memories/delete` | 删除 `{ids:[...]}` |
| POST | `/__dsh_memory__/recreate` | 重建集合 `{confirm:"DELETE"}` |
| POST | `/__dsh_memory__/maintenance` | 立即维护 |

POST 需要请求头 `x-dsh-memory: 1`。

## 测试连接
![测试连接](docs/screenshots/test-connection.png)

## 已知限制

- 嵌入维度与 Qdrant 集合绑定：切换维度不同的 provider 前需要「重建集合」（会清空记忆）。
- 自动召回会给每轮增加一次嵌入请求（约 100–300ms；可配置超时，超时自动跳过）。
- 召回内容会作为 `source=long-term-memory` 的上下文消息进入会话日志（DSH 要求模型可见内容可回放）。
- 图片概览依赖 provider 的视觉模型；未配置时自动降级为占位记录。
- 因 DSH HMR 限制，Host 代码改动需通过 `node build.mjs` 重新生成 `index.js` 后才生效。
- 时间显示基于记录的 epoch 时间戳，切换时区只影响显示与“今天/近 7 天”等自然日边界，不改变已存数据。

## 更新记录

- **v0.3.1**：修复自动召回失效 —— 插件 `inject` 名单缺少 `sessions` 服务，
  导致召回阶段读取会话上下文报错（`cannot get property "sessions" without inject`）而被静默跳过；
  已补上并热重载验证：新会话可正常召回、`lastRecallError` 为空、召回内容带当前时间与相对时间。
- **v0.3.0**：时区与时间感知（时区选择 / 相对时间 / 召回附带当前时间 / 时间范围筛选）。
- **v0.2.0**：多 provider 档案管理、记忆管理界面、记忆范围、定期维护。
- **v0.1.0**：首个可用版本（硅基流动 + Qdrant，自动记录/召回与记忆工具）。

plugins.description: Video and audio preview for DeepSeek Harness: play mp4/mov/mkv/webm and mp3/flac/wav in the right-Sidebar document preview, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-media-preview

Video and audio preview for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): play `mp4`, `mov`, `mkv`, `webm` and `mp3`, `flac`, `wav` right inside the right-Sidebar document preview instead of the built-in “this format cannot be previewed” empty state.

**中文** | English (this file) · [中文说明](README.zh.md)

## Why

The built-in preview registers renderers for text, code, Markdown, images, PDF, HTML, Office and spreadsheets, and lists video/audio suffixes as *known binary containers with no renderer* — so opening a video shows an icon and one line of text. This plugin registers those suffixes and draws the browser's native player, fed by an authenticated streaming route that honours HTTP `Range`, so seeking works and a 2 GB file is never loaded into memory or into the conversation.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-media-preview
```

Then restart the desktop app (a profile patch change is read at boot). No configuration is required; the defaults cover the common suffixes.

To check it loaded, open any `.mp4` from the Files tab: the preview pane shows the player rather than the unsupported-format notice.

![Video preview](docs/video-preview.png)
![Audio preview](docs/audio-preview.png)

## What it does

- **Renderer** — registers two document-previews implementations, `dsh-media-preview/media` (video suffixes) and `dsh-media-preview/audio` (audio suffixes), with priority `extension`, `loading: 'renderer'`, and their suffixes declared binary so the “plain text” fallback is not offered.
- **Player** — a native `<video>`/`<audio>` element with the browser's own controls. The video is fitted into the pane with `object-fit: contain` inside a flexible frame, so a portrait or landscape clip is fully visible at once, with black letterboxing instead of spilling past the preview edge. Below it sit **倍速 / Speed** (cycles 1× → 1.25× → 1.5× → 1.75× → 2× → 0.5× → 0.75×), **循环 / Loop**, and — for video — **全屏 / Full screen** and **画中画 / Picture in picture**. Speed and loop also apply to audio, and the choice is remembered per browser. Audio shows a card with the file name, its size and the player. The body reports `loaded` / `failed` back to the document preview owner so the tab's loading state settles.
- **Stream** — a Host route `GET|HEAD /api/media-preview?path=<absolute path>` that answers `200` with `Accept-Ranges: bytes`, `206` with `Content-Range` for one byte window, `416` with `Content-Range: bytes */size` for an unsatisfiable window, and `HEAD` with headers only. It reads the file a chunk at a time (`chunkBytes`, 1 MiB by default) through `ctx.fs.readByteRange`, so memory stays flat.
- **Authentication** — the route lives under `/api/`, which means the composition's connection service applies its Host/Origin fence and browser-session cookie check before the handler runs. A cross-site page cannot read local files through it.

## Configuration

Settings live on the `media-preview` entry (Settings → Plugins, or the profile patch). Every key has a code-side default, so a partial config is valid.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Mount the route at all. _Off_ leaves the renderer registered but transfers no bytes (`503`). |
| `routePath` | `/api/media-preview` | Route pathname. Must start with `/api/`; anything else falls back to the default so the auth fence still applies. |
| `maxBytes` | `2147483648` (2 GiB) | Largest file served; larger files answer `413`. |
| `chunkBytes` | `1048576` | Bytes per ranged read. |
| `videoExtensions` | `mp4, m4v, mov, webm, ogv, ogg, mkv, avi, wmv, flv, 3gp, ts, m2ts, mts` | Suffixes the video player claims. |
| `audioExtensions` | `mp3, wav, flac, m4a, aac, oga, opus, weba, wma, aiff, aif` | Suffixes the audio player claims. |

The browser half mirrors the suffix lists in `lib/client.js`; keep them in sync when changing either side. The route path is published to the page as `__DSH_MEDIA_PREVIEW_CONFIG__` by the Host, so a configured path and the player's URL never drift apart.

## Playback support

Playback depends on the browser's own codecs, not on this plugin. Chromium/Electron plays MP4 (H.264/AAC), WebM (VP8/VP9/Opus), Ogg and most audio formats. **Matroska (`.mkv`) and AVI usually do not decode** in Chromium; the player then reports “浏览器不支持这个编码 / This codec is not supported by the browser” and the _Open in app_ control in the preview header still hands the file to the system player. Remuxing such files to MP4/WebM is the reliable fix.

## How it is built

```
lib/index.js    Host entry: name / inject / Config / apply (route + index injection)
lib/config.js   Defaults and normalization, no host imports (unit-testable)
lib/schema.js   schemastery Config for the loader/settings page
lib/range.js    HTTP Range interpretation, pure functions
lib/mime.js     Suffix → media type
lib/route.js    The authenticated streaming handler (fetch-shaped, chunked)
lib/client.js   Browser bundle: renderers, bodies, styles, copy
test/           node --test: range, config, route, adapter mount, client bundle
scripts/        Headless browser E2E + HTTP probe used for verification
```

The browser half is a hand-written module-loader bundle (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`) with `react` and `react/jsx-runtime` as its only module-table requests, so it needs no build step and cannot drift from the Host's React copy.

## Development

```sh
node --test test/*.test.js
```

For end-to-end checks, start a host with the plugin installed and run the probe:

```sh
node scripts/e2e-browser.mjs --base http://127.0.0.1:<port> --token <token> --video "<absolute path to a video>"
```

`E2E_BROWSER_CHANNEL=msedge` makes Playwright use the system Edge when the bundled Chromium is unavailable.

## Known limitations

- One byte window per request; a multi-range `Range` header is answered `416`. Browsers only ever ask a media element for one window.
- `.mkv`, `.avi`, `.wmv`, `.flv` are claimed and listed, but Chromium cannot decode them; the plugin shows the player's error state rather than pretending they play.
- No playlist, subtitle-track or speed controls of its own — the native controls own those.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH Web 插件：给文件引用加右键菜单（打开文件 / 在资源管理器定位 / 浏览器预览 / 复制路径）。Right-click actions for file mentions in DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-file-actions

给 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面里的文件引用加右键菜单。

Right-click menu for file references in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.1.1--rc.2-blue.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![Topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0284c7.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

---

## 它解决什么问题 / The problem

DSH 会把消息里的文件引用渲染成蓝色 chip，例如 `index.html`、`@src/app.tsx`。它们看起来像可以点的链接，实际只能看，想打开文件还得手动去资源管理器里翻。

`dsh-file-actions` 让这些引用支持右键：直接打开文件、在资源管理器里定位、用浏览器预览、复制完整路径。

DSH renders file mentions as blue chips (`index.html`, `@src/app.tsx`). They look clickable but are not. This plugin adds a context menu so you can open the file, reveal it in Explorer, preview it in a browser, or copy its absolute path.

## 功能 / Features

| 菜单项 | 适用文件 | 行为 |
|---|---|---|
| 用默认程序打开 | 全部 | 交给 Windows 文件关联 |
| 用浏览器打开 | html / svg / md / txt / json / xml / yaml / css / js / ts 等文本类 | 以 `file:///` URL 交给默认浏览器 |
| 在文件夹中显示 | 全部 | 打开资源管理器并选中该文件 |
| 复制完整路径 | 全部 | 写入剪贴板 |

菜单头部显示文件名与完整路径，长路径左侧渐隐，方便确认打开的是哪一个。

以下三种引用形态都能识别：

- `[data-ref-chip]` 元素（DSH 渲染的蓝色文件 chip）
- `file:///` 形式的链接
- 内容像本地路径的行内代码（`code` 元素）

## 安装 / Install

### 方式一：dsh plugin 命令（推荐）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-file-actions"
```

随后在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里追加 `"dsh-file-actions"`，重启桌面应用。

> `dsh plugin` 会把参数原样转发给 pnpm。路径含空格时会被拆词，此时请改用方式二。

### 方式二：手工 link（路径含空格时）

1. 在 `profiles/<profile>/package.json` 的 `dependencies` 加一条：
   ```json
   "dsh-file-actions": "link:E:/path/to/dsh-file-actions"
   ```
2. 在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 追加 `"dsh-file-actions"`。
3. 在 `profiles/<profile>/node_modules/` 下建一个指向本目录的目录联接（Junction）：
   ```powershell
   New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "<profile>/node_modules/dsh-file-actions" -Target "E:\path\to\dsh-file-actions"
   ```
4. 重启 DSH 桌面应用。

`$DSH_HOME` 默认是 `~/.dsh`。桌面端使用 `desktop` profile，纯 Web 端使用 `web` profile。

### 卸载

删掉 `node_modules/dsh-file-actions` 与 `bundles` 里的那一行即可。插件不修改任何既有文件。

## 权限与安全边界 / Permissions & safety

这是一个**会执行本机命令**的插件，装之前请明确知道它做了什么。

- **三个动作，白名单**：`reveal` / `open` / `browser`。接口不接受任意命令字符串。
- **路径必须真实存在**：宿主在执行前做 `existsSync` 与 `stat` 校验，不存在的路径直接返回 400。
- **不做 shell 字符串拼接**：全部通过 `spawn` 的参数数组传递，路径不会被当作命令解释。
- **不读文件内容**：宿主只做定位与打开，不读取、不上传任何文件正文。
- **无外部网络请求**：客户端只向同源的 `/api/file-actions/exec` 发 POST。
- **无依赖**：`dependencies` 为空，没有生命周期脚本（`preinstall` / `install` / `postinstall` / `prepare` 都不存在）。

This plugin spawns local Windows processes. It exposes exactly three whitelisted actions, validates that the target path exists, passes arguments as arrays (never shell-interpolated strings), never reads file contents, and makes no outbound network requests.

## 兼容性 / Compatibility

- 在 DeepSeek Harness `0.1.1-rc.2` + Windows 上开发与验证。
- 依赖 DSH 把文件引用渲染为 `[data-ref-chip]`、`file://` 链接或 `code` 元素。三者任一变体都可识别；若上游渲染结构整体更换，右键会失效，需要在 `lib/client.js` 的 `resolveFromEvent` 里补选择器。
- 系统动作部分使用 Windows 的 `explorer.exe` 与 `cmd.exe /c start`，其他平台需要替换 `lib/index.js` 里的 `launch` 调用。

## 已知限制 / Known limitations

- 相对路径引用（如 `index.html`）按宿主进程当前工作目录解析，解析不到会提示 `path does not exist`。
- 菜单样式跟随 DSH 设计 token，深浅色主题自动适配。
- 未做键盘全流程导航（Esc 关闭已实现，方向键在菜单项间移动尚未实现）。
- 系统动作（真的弹出资源管理器/浏览器）没有自动化测试覆盖，需要人工点一次确认。

## 开发 / Development

```
lib/index.js         宿主侧：注册 /api/file-actions 路由，执行系统动作
lib/client.js        客户端侧：捕获 contextmenu，识别引用，渲染菜单
scripts/verify.mjs   自检
```

自检：

```bash
node scripts/verify.mjs
```

覆盖包元数据、客户端语法、路由注册、健康检查，以及未知动作 / 不存在路径 / 空路径 / 非法路由四个拒绝分支。共 12 项。

健康检查接口：

```
GET /api/file-actions/health
```

## 许可证 / License

[MIT](LICENSE)

---

如果这个插件帮你省了几次在资源管理器里翻文件的时间，点个 Star 会让更多人看到它。

## 联系 / Contact

有问题、想提需求、或者想聊聊 DSH 插件开发，都可以直接发邮件。

邮箱：**1992335297@qq.com**

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

Its egress report goe

plugins.description: A configurable direct channel for the DeepSeek Harness LLM egress: a keep-alive undici Agent with adjustable connect/headers/body/keep-alive timeouts, IPv4-forcing, HTTP/2 off by default, automatic stand-down behind a proxy, and a read-only status route. A minimal patch, one file, zero dependencies.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-undici-timeout

[![awesome · DSH plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)

DSH 插件：给 LLM 出口（`globalThis.fetch` → Node 内置 undici）换一条**可配置超时 + 可保活复用**的直连通道。

English: [README.en.md](README.en.md)　·　发布流程: [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md)　·　收录条目: [`contrib/awesome-dsh-plugin/`](contrib/awesome-dsh-plugin/)

## 为什么需要它

- Node 内置 `fetch` 背后的 undici，`connectTimeout` 固定 **10s**（DNS+TCP+TLS 全算在内），
  没有环境变量/参数可调；
- 本机（WSL）直连 `opencode.ai` 的新建握手实测出现过 **11.6s**，双栈探测也常整轮
  `AggregateError`（IPv6 无出口 + IPv4 抖动）；
- pi-ai 每次重试都 `new OpenAI(...)` → `Shims.getDefaultFetch()` **当场读全局 fetch**，
  所以每次尝试都是新 TCP+TLS，被 10s 砍掉 → `TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT` → 重试又重连。
  今天（2026-10-13）的日志：87 次 TIMEOUT + 8 次 TRANSPORT，autoswitch 开代理 10 次。

对比：OpenCode（Go 客户端）全程复用一条已建立的 HTTP/2 连接，握手只发生一次，
所以同样的网络下它不超时。本插件就是把这套「长超时 + 保活复用」搬给 DSH。

## 这东西的寿命：它是一个补丁，不是一块功能

它存在的理由只有两条，而且两条都在**上游**，不是 DSH 的既定设计：

1. Node 内置 `fetch` 的 `connectTimeout` 固定 **10s** 且没有开关（Node/undici 上游行为）；
2. undici 8 把 `allowH2` 的默认值翻成 `true`，而 Cloudflare 边缘对 h2 上的 SSE 长流会
   回 `NGHTTP2_ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM`（上游默认值 × 边缘策略）。

这两条一旦在 DSH 侧被解决 —— 比如 LLM 层允许指定 dispatcher / 连接超时，或者换掉内置
fetch —— 本插件就**没有存在价值了**，直接卸掉：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-undici-timeout   # 或者删掉 profile 里那条 insert
```

判断「可以卸了」的依据（任一条成立即可）：

- 状态路由 `stats` 长期没有 `TIMEOUT`，且直连握手不再接近 10s；
- DSH 的 LLM 层能自己配连接超时 / 强制复用连接（看 release notes，或
  `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 里出现了对应配置项）；
- 上游把内置 fetch 换成了自带 Agent 的实现。

在那之前它是**最小补丁**：单文件、零依赖、只接管白名单域名、随时可摘。
所以只从 GitHub 分发，不发 npm、不进插件市场。

## 原理

```
agent 回合
 └─ dsh-llm-retry（重试）→ dsh-llm-pi-ai → pi-ai → new OpenAI({ fetch: undefined })
      → openai/client.mjs: this.fetch = Shims.getDefaultFetch()   ← 每次尝试当场读全局
      → 【本插件包装过的 globalThis.fetch】
           ├─ 命中 hosts 白名单 且 无代理 env → undici.fetch(url, { dispatcher: 自建 Agent })
           └─ 其它（代理模式 / 非白名单 / Request 输入）→ 原样透传给原来的 fetch
```

- 用**解析到的那份 undici**（`argv[1]` → profile 扫描 → bare）自建 `Agent`：
  `connect.timeout`、`headersTimeout`、`bodyTimeout`、`keepAliveTimeout/MaxTimeout`、
  `pipelining`、可选 `family`。
- **不碰 `setGlobalDispatcher`**：那是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-http-proxy` 的地盘（代理联动靠它），
  抢了会把 net-proxy 弄坏。本插件只接管「本来要走直连」的那部分流量。
- 代理 env（`http_proxy/https_proxy/ALL_PROXY` 任一大写或小写）在场时**自动让路**，
  由 harness 的代理层处理——所以能和 `dsh-net-proxy` / `dsh-net-autoswitch` 共存。

## 配置项（`cordis.patch.yml` 里本插件的 `config:`）

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关。`false` 时不改 fetch，状态路由仍在。 |
| `hosts` | `["opencode.ai"]` | 命中这些域名（含子域）才接管；`"*"` = 全部直连流量。 |
| `connectTimeoutMs` | `30000` | **核心项**。DNS+TCP+TLS 的总预算（内置固定 10s）。范围 1000–600000。 |
| `headersTimeoutMs` | `300000` | 等响应头。 |
| `bodyTimeoutMs` | `0` | 相邻 body 块间隔；`0`=关闭，卡流交给 pi-ai 的 `streamIdleTimeoutMs` 看门狗。 |
| `keepAliveTimeoutMs` | `60000` | 空闲连接保留时长（复用 = 不重握手）。 |
| `keepAliveMaxTimeoutMs` | `600000` | 保活上限。 |
| `pipelining` | `1` | 每连接并发请求数。 |
| `family` | `0` | `0`=跟随系统；`4`/`6`=强制 IP 族（本机 IPv6 无出口时 `4` 很划算）。 |
| `allowH2` | `false` | **⚠️ 见下面「h2 的坑」**。undici 8 把 `allowH2` 的默认值翻成了 `true`，不显式关掉，本插件会顺手把 LLM 出口从 h1 换成 h2。 |
| `autoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeoutMs` | `0` | Node happy-eyeballs 的**地址轮换间隔**（默认 250ms）。注意：尝试是**并行保留**的，这个值不是单地址的放弃窗口——黑洞地址实测默认与调大都会等到 connect 超时才死，改大只会拖慢轮换，一般别动。保留它只为极端调优。 |
| `delegateOnProxyEnv` | `true` | 有代理 env 时让路。 |
| `undiciPath` | `""` | 留空自动解析；可显式指到某份 `undici/index.js`。 |
| `probeOnStart` | `true` | 启动时打一次探针（默认打 LLM 网关的 models 端点，不花 token）。 |
| `probeUrl` / `probeTimeoutMs` | `…/zen/go/v1/models` / `15000` | 探针目标与超时。 |
| `logSlowMs` | `0` | >0 时把达到该耗时的请求写日志。 |
| `logFailures` | `true` | 失败请求记日志（含 cause）。 |
| `routePath` | `/_dsh/undici-timeout` | 状态路由。 |
| `logFile` | `$DSH_HOME/logs/dsh-undici-timeout/host.log` | 日志落盘。 |

## 安装

**只从 GitHub 分发**（本插件是上游行为的补丁，不发 npm、不上市场）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:mqnu00/dsh-undici-timeout
```

装完**重启 DSH** 生效。也可以钉住某个版本：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:mqnu00/dsh-undici-timeout#v0.1.1
```

零 npm 依赖、无构建步骤，所以 pnpm 不会弹 `allowBuilds` 授权（本插件没有任何
`prepare` / `install` 脚本）。⚠️ 别和下面路线 B 的 `file://` 直插**同时用**：
包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 insert id 也是 `undici-timeout`，同 id 冲突。

改完代码想知道「别人 clone 下来到底装不装得上」，本地跑一遍试装验证 —— 把包装进一个
临时 DSH_HOME 里的干净 profile、真启动一次、再请求插件自己的状态路由：

```bash
./scripts/trial-install.sh          # 走 tarball（等价于 GitHub Release 资产）
./scripts/trial-install.sh --git    # 走本地裸仓库 git+file://（等价于 github: 源）
./scripts/trial-install.sh --spec=github:mqnu00/dsh-undici-timeout   # 直接验真实远端
# 🎉 试装验证通过 = 组合成功 + 启动就绪 + 状态路由应答
```

打 tag / 建 Release 的步骤见 [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md)。

### 路线 B：file:// 直插 profile 用户层（改代码时用这条）

`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: undici-timeout
      name: file:///home/mqnu/program/dsh/dsh-undici-timeout/lib/index.js?v=5
      config:
        enabled: true
        hosts: [opencode.ai]
        connectTimeoutMs: 30000
        # 本机 IPv6 无出口：别让地址族探测把预算烧在 10 个死地址上
        family: 4
        # undici 8 的 allowH2 默认是 true，不关掉就会把出口换成 h2（见「h2 的坑」）
        allowH2: false
        bodyTimeoutMs: 0
        keepAliveTimeoutMs: 60000
```

`dsh-hmr` 会监听该文件，**原地写** 2 秒内自动重挂（tmp+rename 会换 inode，收不到事件）。
⚠️ insert 行按 **id 幂等**：只改 `name`（换 `?v=`）或改 `config` 不会立刻重挂——要么**摘掉再插回**，
要么重启 DSH（HMR 的实测行为，和 dsh-net-autoswitch 一致）。
2026-10-15 复验：只把 `?v=4` 改成 `?v=5` 并加配置，HMR 确实重挂了（实例 id、`installedAt`
都换新），但**跑的还是旧模块代码** —— 日志里没有新加的 `h2=off` 字段，状态路由里也读不到
`allowH2`。原因就是同 id 的 entry 按**旧 URL** 重新 import。**摘掉（等 HMR 跑一轮）→ 再插回**，
这次 `?v=5` 才真正被 import，`h2=off` 出现在日志里。改代码务必按这个顺序。

## h2 的坑（2026-10-15 定位，`allowH2` 就是为它加的）

症状：插件明明在跑（`matched` 一直涨），却仍然「很频繁地失败」，重试日志里
`code=TRANSPORT` 暴涨。

根因是一条**静默换协议**：

| | 用的 undici | ALPN 实测 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 内置 `fetch`（Node 22 自带） | 6.24.1 | `http/1.1` | h1 |
| 本插件（`argv` 解析到 harness 那份） | 8.11.2 | `h2` | **h2** |

undici 8 把 `allowH2` 的默认值从 `false` 翻成了 `true`
（`lib/core/connect.js`: `allowH2 = allowH2 != null ? allowH2 : true`，
`lib/dispatcher/client.js`: “enabled by default”）。我们用 undici 8 建 Agent，
于是 LLM 出口从 h1 变成了 h2 —— 这不是本插件想要的，却实实在在换了传输层。

代价：`opencode.ai` 前面是 Cloudflare，h2 上的 SSE 长流会被边缘掐：

```
请求失败 CONNECTION（2275ms）…/chat/completions :: ERR_HTTP2_STREAM_ERROR / Stream closed with error code NGHTTP2_ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM
```

- 2026-10-15 当天：插件记了 **85 次失败，其中 79 次是 nghttp2 流错误**（93%），
  全部落在 `/chat/completions`（长流），`/models`（短请求）一次都没有；
- 首次出现 `ERR_HTTP2` 是 **2026-10-14T07:00**，即代理被关掉、插件开始全量接管直连之后；
  重试日志里 `TRANSPORT` 从 ~10/天 → **201/天**（10-14），`TIMEOUT` 则从 238/天 → 4/天
  （**插件治超时的效果是真的**，只是换了个失败形态）。

修法：`allowH2: false`（已进 DEFAULTS）。关掉之后复用一点没少：

| 4 连发（读完 body） | 新建连接数 | 耗时 |
|---|---|---|
| `allowH2: false` | 1 | 924ms → 383 → 363 → 374ms |
| `allowH2: true` | 1 | 947ms → 340 → 350 → 349ms |

即 h1 + `keepAliveTimeout` 的复用与 h2 等价，「不重握手」的目标照旧达成，
而 Cloudflare 那套 h2 流控彻底不参与。

2026-10-15 03:31 热更后（`?v=5`，`family=4` + `allowH2:false`）现场复验：
**75 秒内 22 个请求（全是 `/chat/completions`）20 成功 0 失败，`ERR_HTTP2` 0 次** ——
同一台机器、同一分钟里，改之前是 85 次失败/天、其中 93% 是这个 h2 流错误。

## 直连失败的另一半：20 个地址里的 10 个是死的（2026-10-15 实测）

`opencode.ai` 的 DNS 一次回 **10 个 IPv4 + 10 个 IPv6**，本机 **IPv6 无出口**
（`curl -6` 秒失败）。地址族探测（happy eyeballs）会把预算烧在这 10 个死地址上：

| 同一分钟内的对照 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 裸 TCP 连 10 个 IPv4 | 全部成功，245–1332ms |
| `curl`（双栈）/ `curl -4` | 8/8、5/5 成功，connect 0.27–0.46s |
| **内置 fetch**（undici 6） | **2/6 成功**，4 次 `UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`，~2511ms |
| **插件 Agent，family=0** | **6/6 成功**，中位 352ms |
| 插件 Agent，family=4 | 6/6 成功，中位 379ms |

所以「插件生效了吗」的答案是：**生效，而且比内置通道明显强**；
但 `connectTimeoutMs: 30000` 救不了这种形态 —— 整轮在 ~1.0s / ~2.5s 就死掉，
是地址族探测把整轮判死，不是 10s 的 connect 预算不够。`family: 4` 能把这半边也堵上。

WSL 里直连脆弱、本机代理（`127.0.0.1:10808`）实测 3/3 HTTP 200（~0.9s）——
代理开着时插件按设计让路，也就不会被 h2 那套流控碰到。

## 状态/排障

```bash
# 读状态（在机器上直接 curl；Host 白名单只放行回环/本机网卡）
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3080/_dsh/undici-timeout | python3 -m json.tool

# 手动补一枪探针
curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3080/_dsh/undici-timeout \
  -H 'x-dsh-undici-timeout: 1' -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"action":"probeNow"}'
```

- `stats.matched/ok/failed/byError`：接管了多少请求、失败怎么归类；
- `stats.delegatedProxy`：因代理 env 让路了多少（联动在工作就正常）；
- `stats.lastRequests`：最近 10 条（host/path/ms/status/error）；
- `lastProbe`：最近一次探针（启动探针也会写日志）。
- 日志：`~/.dsh/logs/dsh-undici-timeout/host.log`。

冒烟（不经过 DSH，验证解析与网络）：

`

plugins.description: Offline HAR diagnostics with minimal evidence for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# HAR Triage

Offline network evidence for DeepSeek Harness. Find failed and slow browser requests without handing the agent your URLs, cookies or response bodies.

浏览器网络排障插件：读取本地 HAR，生成可回查原始请求索引的离线诊断报告。默认不把网址、请求头、Cookie、参数值或正文带进报告和 AI 工具结果。

![Synthetic HAR diagnosis: signals, source indexes and timing evidence](docs/report-demo.jpg)

The screenshot uses the bundled synthetic scenario, not real browser traffic.

## What it does

- Reads an existing HAR 1.2 capture; never records traffic, sends requests, or changes the capture.
- Groups requests into endpoint aliases, highlights HTTP 4xx/5xx, unavailable responses, slow requests and long waiting phases.
- Produces a self-contained HTML report: signals → request row → measured timing phases. Filters, pagination and source locators work offline.
- Returns at most 20 evidence entries to the agent, with a count of omitted evidence. The full numeric projection stays in the local JSON/HTML files.

Request #43 corresponds to `log.entries[42]` in your original HAR. Endpoint aliases deliberately do not reveal names. Keep the original capture private and use its index to look up the actual request locally.

## Install in Harness

Node 22.19+ is required. Install the prebuilt bundle into your chosen profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE add https://github.com/po-et/dsh-har-triage/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-har-triage-0.1.0.tgz
dsh --profile YOUR_PROFILE --dump-config
```

The configuration should contain the `har-triage` row. Start that profile, put your HAR inside its session workspace, and ask:

> Inspect capture.har with har_triage. Save reports in a new har-review directory. Explain the measured evidence and cite the original HAR entry indexes. Do not guess root causes.

Tool arguments:

```json
{"input":"capture.har","outputDir":"har-review","slowMs":2000}
```

The tool uses Harness filesystem and sandbox services. It requires write permission to create the reports and refuses input/output paths outside the session workspace. Existing report files are never overwritten. Uninstall with `dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE remove dsh-har-triage`.

## Try without Harness

The CLI and analysis/report modules use Node built-ins only. From a source checkout:

```sh
node src/cli.js capture.har --out new-report-directory --slow-ms 2000
```

Open `new-report-directory/report.html`. The output directory must not exist. The original capture is unchanged.

For a reproducible synthetic example:

```sh
npm run demo
```

This creates a new directory under `artifacts/` with a deliberately synthetic capture and its report. It is not evidence of real browser traffic or real users.

## Evidence, not root-cause claims

`503` means the capture records a server-error response. `status: 0` means it did not record a valid HTTP response. Neither identifies a failing service, proves CORS, or proves an expired token. A high wait/TTFB share is an observation, not proof that the backend or database is slow.

Unknown phase timings and byte sizes remain `-1`, displayed as “Unknown.” TLS is part of the HAR connection timing and is not added a second time. Contradictory phase durations are flagged; the report hides misleading proportions.

## What is retained and removed

Retained: source entry index, sequential endpoint alias, controlled method/status/content classes, relative offsets, numeric durations/sizes, and fixed diagnostic codes. Aliases group the same method/origin/path within one capture; query strings and fragments do not affect grouping.

Removed: complete URLs including origins and paths, query values, headers, cookies, request/response bodies, page titles, initiator data, IP addresses, absolute timestamps, extension fields, raw error text, and the original file digest. The report ID hashes only the retained projection. Arbitrary source strings are not copied to reports or tool evidence.

This is a minimal diagnostic projection, **not** a scrubbed HAR, an anonymization guarantee, or a replacement for reviewing an artifact before sharing it. Status patterns, sizes, timing, request counts and grouping can still identify an application. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Limits

- HAR JSON only: version `1.2`, UTF-8, at most 16 MiB and 10,000 entries. Invalid supported entries fail with fixed errors rather than silently truncating the evidence.
- HTTP and HTTPS requests are analyzed. Other protocols are excluded and counted. Missing timing/size values are retained as unknown; a valid request URL, start timestamp, duration, status and response content object are required.
- Synchronous bounded analysis: cancellation is checked before parsing and between entries, not an interruptible worker. The slow threshold defaults to 2,000 ms and is configurable per call.
- Reports are created exclusively. If HTML creation fails after JSON creation, the JSON is retained and the tool reports the partial result; retry using a fresh destination.
- No upload, traffic replay, header inspection, body analysis, automatic source lookup, or edits to the original HAR.

## Development and validation

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm test
npm run smoke:host
npm pack --dry-run
```

48 tests passed on Node 24 and 26. They cover actual CLI subprocesses, controlled output and failure text, input limits, phases, original-file preservation, and real Cordis tool dispatch/filesystem/sandbox/Loader integration. `smoke:host` is a real service composition, not a CLI profile boot or a live-LLM test.

The packed bundle was separately installed through the actual CLI into fresh temporary Profiles on Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.2`, then booted with `runProfile` and exercised through `har_triage`. Source bytes were unchanged; output omitted the synthetic canary; overwrite and workspace-escape attempts were refused. HMR was disabled only in those temporary Profiles. The alpha host emitted three unrelated Typert activation warnings; rc.2 did not. No LLM or real credentials were used.

Browser checks covered status filtering, signal-to-request navigation, correct source locators, no console errors, and a 390-pixel layout without page-level overflow. The demo and regression captures are synthetic; real-user usefulness is not yet validated.

## Related tools

[net-debug](https://github.com/JohnXu22786/net-debug) is an existing Harness HTTP client with history, replay and HAR export. [harlite](https://github.com/brucehart/harlite) already offers extensive HAR analysis, SQL, waterfall and HTML reporting. This plugin does not replace those tools: its narrower purpose is a Harness-native, no-external-binary, allowlisted evidence path for agent-assisted debugging.

MIT licensed.

plugins.description: Codex-style window-swap compaction engine: deterministic pointer-template summaries with zero LLM calls, replacing the default LLM-summary compaction.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-compaction-codex

Codex 式换窗压缩引擎——彻底替换官方 dsh-compaction-basic 的「LLM 摘要式压缩」。

## 机制

- 继承官方 `BasicCompactionEngine`，只覆写官方承诺的唯一子类钩子 `summarize()`；
- 摘要改为**纯确定性指针模板（零 LLM 调用）**：归档声明 + 恢复通道指引（history_search / history_read / notes read）+ 最近 model 检查点笔记全文（读 `~/.dsh/context-budget/notes/<sid>.jsonl`，只读）+ 被归档区首尾消息截断锚点；
- SummaryResult 走官方契约的模板分支（无 `llmStreamCall` 字段，官方注释点名 "template, remote, or other summarizer"），转录中 `compaction/summary` 事件显示 `provider: template, model: codex-rollover`；
- shadow 事务、replay 定价、工具配对平衡、并发锁、阈值自动触发（0.8×窗口，router-standard 为 0.55）、context-overflow 恢复、/compact（compactNow）全部原样继承。

## 装配

- 源码：`~/.dsh/plugins-src/dsh-compaction-codex/`（本目录），构建：`bash scripts/build.sh`（链接 dsh-install 类型依赖 + tsc 编译 src → lib）；
- profile 链：`~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-compaction-codex` 软链 + `package.json` link 依赖（防 pnpm install 剪掉）；
- 预设：6 个用户预设（code / code-guarded / code-lean / dshagent / designharness / router-standard）compaction 组中 `compaction-basic` 条目已替换为 `compaction-codex`（2026-09-29，各文件留有 `.bak-20260929` 备份）；
- 生效范围：仅新会话（预设热扫描；运行中会话保持旧代装配）。

## 约束与边缘

- 官方 `summarizeCompaction` 要求摘要帧 token 数 < 被 shadow 内容 token 数；本模板上限约 5K 字符（约 1.5K tokens），对数千 tokens 以上的压缩区安全；极小压缩区会按官方逻辑抛错并留在日志（不会静默）；
- notes 文件缺失/损坏时自动降级（省略检查点段），不阻塞压缩事务；
- 回滚：预设 yml 中把 name 改回 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic`（或恢复 .bak）即回官方 LLM 摘要，热生效（新会话）。

## 决策记录

- 2026-09-29 用户拍板：方案 A（子类替换）+ 纯 Codex 式（永不 LLM 摘要，无混合开关）；
- 否决方案 B（从零实现抽象 CompactionEngine：需重写 shadow 持久化/锁/配对平衡，收益零风险高）与方案 C（拆压缩组：长会话必撞上下文硬上限）。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-superpowers-verified

**A fork of [Superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers) for the
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH)** —
the full Superpowers methodology (brainstorming, planning, TDD, systematic
debugging, subagent-driven execution) adapted to run on DSH, installed
**verifiably and reversibly**.

Superpowers is an agentic software-development methodology by
[Jesse Vincent](https://blog.fsck.com) / [Prime Radiant](https://primeradiant.com);
this fork adapts it to DeepSeek Harness. It is not affiliated with or endorsed
by the Superpowers project, Prime Radiant, or DeepSeek.

[![tests](https://github.com/dkeviv/dsh-superpowers-verified/actions/workflows/tests.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/dkeviv/dsh-superpowers-verified/actions/workflows/tests.yml)

```
15 skills · DeepSeek Harness (DSH) · 86 tests · live-catalog verification · non-destructive install
```

**Keywords:** Superpowers fork for DeepSeek Harness · DSH skills ·
obra/superpowers port · DeepSeek coding agent skills · TDD · subagent-driven
development · agentic workflow for DSH · `superpowers-dsh` alternative ·
DeepSeek Harness 技能包 · 超级技能

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/dkeviv/dsh-superpowers-verified.git
cd dsh-superpowers-verified
./bin/install.sh --dry-run     # see exactly what will change
./bin/install.sh
```

Then start a fresh DSH session and send `Let's make a react todo list`. A
working install invokes **brainstorming** and asks what you actually want
before writing any code.

**Uninstall reverses it exactly:**

```bash
./bin/install.sh --uninstall
```

## Why this fork exists

Superpowers' skills are mostly harness-neutral, but two things don't carry over
to DSH, and this fork supplies them:

**1. DSH has no session-start hook.** Upstream injects `using-superpowers` via a
`SessionStart` hook (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Muse, Pi, …). DSH's
`dsh-hooks-*` packages *provide* hooks to other harnesses rather than consuming
them. DSH's equivalent channel is its user-global instruction file,
`$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`, loaded every turn of every session — so the bootstrap
goes there, inside self-managed markers.

**2. DSH has a different tool vocabulary.** Nothing here is named `Agent`,
`Task`, `TodoWrite`, or `Skill`. DSH provides `skill`, `todo_write`,
`subagent`/`subagent_fork`/`workflow`, native plan mode, and a file sandbox.
[`references/dsh-tools.md`](references/dsh-tools.md) is the translation layer.
Upstream's platform-adaptation list is rewritten to name DSH **only**: the
Claude Code reference file left in place describes nested-subagent depth tuning
and a `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH` variable that do not exist here.

**3. DSH skill names carry no namespace.** Upstream cross-references its own
skills as `superpowers:writing-plans`, but DSH rejects a colon in a skill name
outright, so those references are unresolvable as written. See
[Known limitations](#known-limitations) — this is the one upstream
incompatibility this fork documents rather than silently patches.

## What makes this fork different

There are several Superpowers ports for DSH. This one is built around two
properties rather than around features:

**Verification against the real catalog, not against prose.** `bin/verify.sh`
mounts DSH's own skill registry and filesystem provider and asks what actually
resolves — then checks it. Around that, `tests/run.sh` is 86 checks covering
snapshot integrity, fidelity against the vendored copy, idempotency, hostile
`AGENTS.md` inputs, migration paths, and uninstall, plus a GitHub Actions matrix
on Ubuntu and macOS. Most ports *assert* DSH compatibility; this one
demonstrates it, and fails loudly when it does not hold.

**An install that cannot damage your setup.** The suite runs entirely in a
throwaway prefix, so it never touches your real skill root or `AGENTS.md`. The
installer owns only the region between its markers, preserves your own
`AGENTS.md` content, appends rather than reorders, and uninstalls exactly what
it installed. Updating means `git pull && ./bin/install.sh` — idempotent, so
running it twice is safe.

**A pinned, auditable snapshot.** The skills are a vendored copy of upstream at
an exact commit ([`vendor/superpowers/README.md`](vendor/superpowers/README.md)),
so installs are offline, reproducible, and diffable against upstream. All
DSH-specific code lives outside `vendor/`.

| | This fork | Typical DSH port |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Install mechanism | Filesystem installer into DSH's native skill roots | Cordis plugin bundle via `dsh plugin add` |
| Compatibility evidence | 86-check suite + live-catalog verifier + 2-OS CI | Prose assertion |
| Install reversibility | Marked-block ownership, exact uninstall | Varies |
| Upstream skills | Pinned commit, vendored | Usually synced at build time |

The plugin-bundle approach is more idiomatic to DSH's internals; the
filesystem approach needs no plugin layer and keeps every change reviewable in
your own config. Pick whichever fits how you run DSH.

## What you get

All 15 Superpowers skills:

| Skill | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `using-superpowers` | Entry point: how to find and use skills |
| `brainstorming` | Draw out intent before building |
| `writing-plans` | Break approved designs into bite-sized tasks |
| `executing-plans` | Inline plan execution, one review at the end |
| `subagent-driven-development` | Fresh subagent per task, reviewed |
| `dispatching-parallel-agents` | Fan independent work out in parallel |
| `systematic-debugging` | Root-cause discipline before fixes |
| `test-driven-development` | RED-GREEN-REFACTOR enforcement |
| `verification-before-completion` | Evidence before claims |
| `requesting-code-review` | Pre-merge review |
| `receiving-code-review` | Evaluate feedback on technical merit |
| `finishing-a-development-branch` | Integrate completed work safely |
| `using-git-worktrees` | Isolated workspaces |
| `writing-skills` | Author and test new skills |
| `diagnosing-superpowers` | Post-mortem a session from its transcript |

## Options

| Option | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `--target <dir>` | Skill root (default `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME/skills` or `~/.agents/skills`) |
| `--dsh-home <dir>` | DSH home holding `AGENTS.md` (default `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh`) |
| `--no-skills` / `--no-bootstrap` | Do just one half |
| `--dry-run` | Print intended changes, write nothing |
| `--uninstall` | Reverse the install |

## Verification

Two independent things, both re-runnable:

```bash
tests/run.sh          # 86 checks, offline, no writes outside a temp dir
bin/verify.sh         # audit a LIVE install against DSH's own skill catalog
```

`bin/verify.sh` is the interesting one. It does not read your files and guess —
it mounts DSH's real skill registry and filesystem provider in a bare Cordis
context (the same code the running harness uses), asks for the resolved
catalog, and checks the answers:

```bash
$ ./bin/verify.sh
Verifying Superpowers for DSH
  modules: /Users/you/.npm/_npx/…/node_modules
  skills:  /Users/you/.agents/skills
  AGENTS:  /Users/you/.dsh/AGENTS.md

  ✓ catalog resolves completely        22 skills
  ✓ every vendored skill resolves from --target   15/15 at …/.agents/skills
  ✓ no resolved skill name uses a namespace
  ✓ every installed skill has a loadable name
  ✓ no skill is shadowed by $DSH_HOME/skills
  ✓ DSH reference file installed
  ✓ adaptation list names DSH
  ✓ no other harness is advertised
  ✓ namespace workaround is documented
  ✓ bootstrap present in AGENTS.md     one balanced block
  ! upstream namespace references      46 references use superpowers:<name>; agents must strip the prefix

10 passed, 1 warnings, 0 failed
```

It exits non-zero when something is actually wrong, so it works in CI or a
pre-commit hook. It catches, among others: a skill that is installed but does
not resolve (including one silently skipped by DSH for an illegal name), a
skill shadowed by a higher-precedence root, a platform list that were reverted
to upstream, an unpaired bootstrap marker, and a missing reference file.

Options: `--target`, `--dsh-home`, `--modules <node_modules>`, `--json`. If it
